title: Reverse Mortgages Explained: The Real Pros and Hidden Cons
bigPicture: A reverse mortgage lets you borrow against your home's value while staying in it, but you still owe money plus fees.
whatYouNeedToKnow: You keep your home and don't make monthly payments, but interest grows over time.
The loan is due when you sell, move out, or pass away.
Proceeds can be cash, monthly checks, or a line of credit, but they reduce your home equity.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Not checking fees and interest rates before signing.
Forgetting that heirs may need to pay back the loan or sell the house.
actionSteps: Talk to a HUD-approved counselor before you decide.
Compare offers from at least three lenders.
